commit 74dba2fec62f6f0e4523e845b3ceb04039dbc4c3
Author:     John Bieling <john@thunderbird.net>
AuthorDate: Sat Jul 4 11:11:14 2026 +0000
Commit:     john@thunderbird.net <john@thunderbird.net>
CommitDate: Sat Jul 4 11:13:21 2026 +0000

    Bug 2052646 - Update test_proxy.js for the removal of Preferences.has(). r=tobyp
    
    Bug 2042698 removed Preferences.has() from Preferences.sys.mjs and updated the
    Firefox copy of the enterprisepolicies test_proxy.js. Thunderbird's forked copy
    still called Preferences.has() and failed with "TypeError: Preferences.has is
    not a function". Mirror the m-c change: use Services.prefs.getPrefType(pref) !=
    Ci.nsIPrefBranch.PREF_INVALID.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D310463

diff --git a/mail/components/enterprisepolicies/tests/xpcshell/test_proxy.js b/mail/components/enterprisepolicies/tests/xpcshell/test_proxy.js
index e03d23478ab..cf03444735d 100644
--- a/mail/components/enterprisepolicies/tests/xpcshell/test_proxy.js
+++ b/mail/components/enterprisepolicies/tests/xpcshell/test_proxy.js
@@ -110,13 +110,13 @@ add_task(async function test_proxy_addresses() {
 
   // Make sure the FTPProxy setting did nothing
   Assert.equal(
-    Preferences.has("network.proxy.ftp"),
-    false,
+    Services.prefs.getPrefType("network.proxy.ftp"),
+    Ci.nsIPrefBranch.PREF_INVALID,
     "network.proxy.ftp should not be set"
   );
   Assert.equal(
-    Preferences.has("network.proxy.ftp_port"),
-    false,
+    Services.prefs.getPrefType("network.proxy.ftp_port"),
+    Ci.nsIPrefBranch.PREF_INVALID,
     "network.proxy.ftp_port should not be set"
   );
 });
title: Bug 2052646 - Update test_proxy.js for the removal of Preferences.has(). r=tobyp
